tests.description: small diff-scoped change in an under-covered module — gap names only the changed behaviour, not the module's other gaps

- The domains module already has tests/flows/__tests__/domain-crud.flow.spec.ts covering create and list, but nothing exercises the new delete-with-children rejection.

- No API, persistence, RBAC, or UI screen behaviour changes.

tests.description: no-new-findings re-review — summary still posted, known inline comments not re-posted

- The new commit only rewords a comment block inside an agent skill file; the reviewer finds no new issues.

tests.description: unit test with a single real managed dependency — integration verdict does not false-positive

- The diff is a single store module plus this unit test.
